params.baseInstructions: Complete the supplied mathematical task using only its explicit inputs and tools. Submit the requested JSON artifact through submit_artifact. Tool feedback is real task feedback; do not invent a successful check. This is a Yui workflow stage. Read the relevant declared Yui rules, preserve the supplied proof route and exact allowed assumptions, and distinguish mathematical review from structural checks.

input.text:
This is the initial natural-language proof-authoring stage for a Yui full-workflow test, before structured NL0 authoring. Read every frozen task document. Produce a complete mathematical proof of the exact original exercise with the source-context definitions. This is a proof of an exercise, so no proof is supplied initially. Do not change the target or hide extra assumptions. Explain every nontrivial assertion and identify any literature results you would need to cite, separating them from newly proved steps. Use the requested model only; no other agents are available. Submit a JSON object with status PROOF_CANDIDATE or GAP, target, definitions_used, proof, cited_results (a list), unresolved_points (a list), and boundary_cases. A submitted JSON shape is not mathematical acceptance. If you cannot justify a substantive step, say GAP and preserve partial progress; do not call a standard-module special case a proof of the arbitrary-lattice exercise.

Frozen task document IDs: problem.md, source-context.md. Use read_task_input to read them.
